text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it raised its estimate for Williams-Sonoma Inc earnings in fiscal 1998 to $1.15 a share from $1.10, and the estimate for fiscal 1999 to $1.40 from $1.39.
-- EVEREN also raised its investment rating for the company to outperform from market performer, citing the retailer's strong recent results. It set a six-month price target of $35 a share.

-- Williams-Sonoma reported strong full year results of $0.86 versus $0.10 as a result of a reversal of inventory write-down, EVEREN said. The company also showed significant improvement in gross margin, operating expenses, inventory turns and profitability, EVEREN said.
-- Williams-Sonoma shares were up 2-1/4 Friday at 32.
